subject: Proposal: bounded Hugging Face L4 paired replication lane; no spend authorized yet
body: Patrick has a few dollars of Hugging Face credit and asked whether a cloud training run is worth considering. Lane B recommends YES, but as a separate bounded replication subject rather than replacing local R2. Current HF Jobs auth is active for @thebrazenbeard and no jobs are running. Current Jobs pricing: L4 24GB $0.80/hour, A10G-small 24GB $1.00/hour, minute-billed. Because the frozen recipe uses bf16, do not use T4 for apples-to-apples training semantics. Proposed cloud lane: (1) first finish/adopt the live Windows [N/A] preflight fix and preserve local R2 as the local executability subject; (2) freeze a distinct HF runtime binding on Linux/CUDA with exact package/model/corpus hashes and exact rows/order; (3) cheap preflight job with hard timeout/cost ceiling; (4) if preflight passes and Patrick explicitly authorizes spend, run BOTH frozen recipe arms on the same L4 runtime: staged 4+8+8 from the same initial trainable digest and fresh continuous20, exact rows/order, panel prohibited; (5) independently validate receipts/hashes; only then consume a separately governed comparison panel if allowed. Do not compare HF continuous against local staged as recipe evidence because hardware/runtime would be a confound. Treat HF result as cross-runtime replication evidence, not exact-digest identity with Windows. Suggested initial spend ceiling: $0.50 with automatic timeout/cancel; raise only with Patrick approval. No paid job should be launched from this message.

artifacts.t4_rejected_reason: frozen recipe requires bf16; avoid hardware-semantic drift
